base_member_text: [L1-L2,L50-L60] (LOW/web-compatibility) The generated page omits a doctype, charset, title, and viewport metadata, leaving standards mode and basic accessibility/metadata behavior unclear.
audit_member_text: [L1-L2,L50-L51] (LOW/html-document-metadata) The page has neither a document type declaration nor a title, leaving browser rendering mode and the page's tab or assistive-technology label unspecified.

base_member_text: [L53-L56] (LOW/template-contract) `${list}` is inserted raw inside HTML with no documented escaping contract, so correctness depends on the generator guaranteeing HTML-safe list content.
audit_member_text: [L55] (LOW/html-substitution-contract) The list placeholder inserts markup directly into the page without specifying that its producer must escape any filename-derived link text and attribute values.

base_member_text: [L37-L41] (LOW/stylesheet) The selector begins immediately after the closing rule as `} html>body`, an old browser-specific CSS hack that is syntactically unusual and not explained.
